prerequisites: At least 80 approved ECTS from mandatory courses from semesters 1-4 from an educational programme at the Faculty of Science and Engineering.

learning_outcomes.text: describe the requirements imposed by working life
know the importance of being able to systematically find and compile relevant information in connection with technical and scientific inquiries
be able to describe the multifaceted roll assumed by present-day professionals

syllabus_topics: Industrial placement in a field related to technology/science
Placement tasks of relevant and technical/scientific nature
Full-time presence at the workplace for at least 3 continuous weeks
Placement report about the project specified in the placement plan
teaching_methods: Individual placement at an organization external to the university
Self-sourcing of industrial placement by student
Formulation and approval of placement plan (by student, workplace supervisor, and examiner)
Workplace provision of a named supervisor
Documentation of industrial placement project in a written report
assessment_rules: The student counsellor verifies the student’s eligibility. Grades are given as ’Fail’ or ’Pass’. Grades for examination modules are decided in accordance with the assessment criteria presented at the start of the course.
degree: Industrial Engineering and Management - International (6CIEI), terms 1-6 (first cycle)
